display.purpose: Landing hero only. Third line runs italic in butter yellow — the most identity-carrying type in the product.

headline.purpose: Landing section closers and the italic profile display name. App section titles sit at the low end (2.25rem / 700).

title.purpose: Recipe card titles, feature headings, panel and settings section titles. Two-line clamp on grid cards, one line in list rows.

body.purpose: Interface prose and input text. Landing prose opens to 1.75 line-height at a 480px measure.

label.purpose: Uppercase section labels (NOTES, tag suggestion groups) and the landing eyebrow at 0.7rem / 0.1em in terracotta.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Cards, primary buttons, menu triggers, notification bell — separation from the cream ground.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Hover state for buttons and triggers; resting state for icon buttons floating over photography.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Card hover, modals, the profile avatar ring. Top of the scale.

shadows.name: terracotta-glow
shadows.purpose: Landing CTA and share-page save button only. Colored shadow is a marketing device, not an app one.

shadows.name: sheet-left
shadows.purpose: Notification panel's left edge as it slides in from the right.

shadows.name: float-banner
shadows.purpose: The clipboard save banner floating above the page.

shadows.name: badge-mark
shadows.purpose: Source badge platform marks, so they stay legible on arbitrary photography without a chip around them.

shadows.name: ring-focus
shadows.purpose: Focus ring on every field, paired with a green border shift. Tokenized as --ring-focus so it cannot drift from --primary.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Card hover (0.25s), notification panel slide (0.22s), profile expand cascade (0.38s).

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: The profile recipe fan's card entrance — the only overshoot in the system.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Default for buttons, links, borders, and color transitions.

motion.name: duration-micro
motion.purpose: Row hovers, menu item hovers, background-only changes.

motion.name: stagger-fan
motion.purpose: Per-card delay in the profile recipe fan.

motion.name: lift-button
motion.purpose: Button hover rise; -2px on the landing CTA.

motion.name: pulse-destructive
motion.purpose: Delete button arming its confirm state.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that moves the user forward. One per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--orange, #C86C44); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.875rem 1.75rem; font-family: var(--font-sans), 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.07); transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--orange-dark, #A14F34); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.11); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(35,75,57,0.28); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: var(--surface-variant, #EEE8DC); color: var(--text-secondary, #6B6055); cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; transform: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The ghost pill that sits beside every primary. Cancel, dismiss, step back.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary, #6B6055); border: 1.5px solid var(--border, #DDD6CA); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.875rem 1.75rem; font-family: var(--font-sans), 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--text-primary, #1A1A1A); color: var(--text-primary, #1A1A1A); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary, #234b39); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(35,75,57,0.15); }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 38px green circle for close, share, and other single-icon actions. Scales up on hover.

components.name: Text Input
components.description: 12px-radius field on white with a 1.5px parchment border and a soft green focus ring.

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The one input that takes pill radius, with the magnifier inset at 2.75rem.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; width: 100%; } .ds-search-icon { position: absolute; left: 1rem; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: var(--text-secondary, #6B6055); pointer-events: none; } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.75rem 1rem 0.75rem 2.75rem; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text-primary, #1A1A1A); border: 1.5px solid var(--border, #DDD6CA); border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-sans), 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; transition: all 0.2s ease; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-secondary, #6B6055); } .ds-search-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary, #234b39); box-shadow: var(--ring-focus, 0 0 0 3px rgb(35 75 57 / 0.1)); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Oat pill at rest, solid green when selected. Wraps to a second line, never scrolls.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-chip-filter { padding: 0.4rem 0.875rem; background: var(--surface-variant, #EEE8DC); color: var(--text-secondary, #6B6055); border: 1.5px solid var(--border, #DDD6CA); border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-sans), 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; text-transform: capitalize; } .ds-chip-filter:hover { border-color: var(--primary, #234b39); color: var(--primary, #234b39); } .ds-chip-filter:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(35,75,57,0.18); } .ds-chip-filter--active { background: var(--primary, #234b39); color: #fff; border-color: var(--primary, #234b39); } .ds-chip-filter--active:hover { background: var(--primary-dark, #132A1F); border-color: var(--primary-dark, #132A1F); color: #fff; } .ds-chip-filter--all { border-style: dashed; }

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 280px; background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1.5px solid var(--border, #DDD6CA); border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.07); transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 16px 32px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.14); border-color: var(--primary, #234b39); } .ds-card-media { position: relative; height: 200px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #EEE8DC 0%, #DDD6CA 60%, #C8BFAE 100%); } .ds-card-badge { position: absolute; top: 0.5rem; left: 0.5rem; line-height: 0; filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)); } .ds-card-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 1.25rem; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 0.75rem 0; font-family: var(--font-serif), Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--text-primary, #1A1A1A); } .ds-card-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; font-family: var(--font-sans), 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-secondary, #6B6055); } .ds-card-dot { color: var(--border, #DDD6CA); } .ds-card-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.375rem; margin-top: 0.75rem; }

components.name: Notification Bell
components.description: 38px circle in the header carrying a terracotta count ringed in the page cream so it reads against the border beneath it.
components.css: .ds-bell { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 38px; height: 38px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text-secondary, #6B6055); border: 1.5px solid var(--border, #DDD6CA); border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.07); transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-bell:hover { border-color: var(--primary, #234b39); color: var(--primary, #234b39); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.11); } .ds-bell:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(35,75,57,0.22); } .ds-bell-badge { position: absolute; top: -4px; right: -4px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 17px; height: 17px; padding: 0 4px; background: var(--orange, #C86C44); color: #fff; border: 1.5px solid var(--background, #FAF7EF); border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-sans), 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; }

narrative.overview:
Deep green enamelware set against cream, trimmed in terracotta. Every surface in RecipeBox behaves like a well-made kitchen object rather than a software panel: it has an edge you can see (a 1.5px border, never a hairline), a weight you can feel (it lifts toward you when you reach for it), and a finish that survives use. The ground is warm paper-cream (#FAF7EF), never white and never grey — white is reserved for the cards that sit on it, which is what makes a card read as an object placed on a counter rather than a region of the page.

The type carries the warmth the palette establishes. Playfair Display names things — recipe titles, page headings, the wordmark, a person's display name — with real serif authority at heavy weights and tight tracking. DM Sans says everything about those things: meta, labels, buttons, body. That split is the system's most consistent rule and the reason a recipe card reads as a clipping rather than a database row.

The product exists to rescue recipes from ad-choked blog pages and lost Instagram saves, so the interface is deliberately the opposite of what it saves from: one column, one action, nothing blinking for attention. It is equally not a generic dashboard. There is no blue, no grey card on a grey background, no Inter. Photography does the loud work; the chrome stays warm, sturdy, and quiet around it.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream ground with white object-cards, never grey-on-grey
Deep green for structure and identity; terracotta for the one action that moves you forward
Playfair Display names things, DM Sans explains them
Visible 1.5px borders everywhere — the edge is part of the design, not a fallback
Cards lift 4px toward the cursor; depth is a response, never decoration
Pill-shaped controls, 12px input fields, 20px content cards, circles for identity
Below 640px, floating chrome becomes 72%-black blurred pills over photography

rules.name: The Green House Rule
rules.body: Deep green is the house — structure, chrome, identity, selected state. It can cover whole regions (nav, hero, profile slab) and it never asks for a click by itself.

rules.name: The One Door Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is the door. It appears on the single action that moves the user forward, and it appears once per view. A screen with two terracotta buttons has one too many; demote the lesser one to the ghost pill. Known AA exception, accepted deliberately: white label text on terracotta measures 3.69:1, below the 4.5:1 bar for normal-size text (it clears 3:1 for large text). Measured 2026-08-07. The hue is a brand commitment; darkening the fill to --orange-dark (5.1:1) was considered and declined. Do not fix this by shifting the terracotta.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: On green or terracotta grounds, controls do not switch palettes — they invert into white-alpha tiers: rgba(255,255,255,0.15) fill, rgba(255,255,255,0.3–0.4) border, rgba(255,255,255,0.85) text, solid white when active.

rules.name: The Warm Grey Rule
rules.body: There is no neutral grey in this system. Every grey is warm (#6B6055, #DDD6CA, #EEE8DC). A cool grey anywhere reads instantly as foreign.

rules.name: The Naming Rule
rules.body: Playfair sets the names of things — recipe titles, page titles, section headings, a person's display name, the wordmark. DM Sans sets everything the interface says about them. A serif button label or a sans recipe title both break the system immediately.

rules.name: The Italic Identity Rule
rules.body: Italic Playfair is reserved for identity moments — the wordmark, the hero's emphasized line, a display name, a stat count. Never body text, quotes, or emphasis in prose.

rules.name: The Wordmark Rule
rules.body: RecipeBox is always set as italic serif with Recipe in terracotta and Box in enamel green, at weight 800 with -0.025em tracking. On green grounds the whole wordmark goes cream. Never one color on cream, never all-caps, never tracked out.

rules.name: The 1060 Rule
rules.body: Content lives in a 1060px column on cream. Full-bleed color is allowed only for the landing hero, the landing CTA, the notification sheet, and the profile composition — surfaces whose job is atmosphere, not task.

rules.name: The Wrap-Never-Scroll Rule
rules.body: Filter and control rows wrap to a second line. They never become horizontal scrollers: off-screen controls read as absent, and a scroll container clips the dropdown menus that open from them.

rules.name: The Counter Rule
rules.body: Cards are objects on a counter. On hover they lift 4px, take the Lifted shadow, and shift their border to enamel green, over 0.25s on cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1). Buttons lift 1–2px on the same idea. Anything that responds to a pointer moves toward it.

rules.name: The Tonal Recess Rule
rules.body: Nothing is pushed back with a shadow. Recessed states — disabled, placeholder, sub-panel, hovered row — drop to oat (#EEE8DC). Inset shadows do not exist in this system.

rules.name: The Full-Bleed Rule
rules.body: Below 640px, a modal stops being a card: it sheds its radius, border, and shadow, fills 100dvh, and its overlay becomes solid white rather than a blurred scrim. Floating chrome over photography converts to rgba(0,0,0,0.72) pills with a 6px backdrop blur.

rules.name: The Pill-For-Action Rule
rules.body: If it can be pressed, it is a pill. A rounded-rectangle button is off-system.

rules.name: The Visible Edge Rule
rules.body: Borders are 1.5px and they are meant to be seen. Do not thin them to 1px for refinement, and do not replace a border with a shadow — in this system the edge is the form.

dos: Do put white cards on the cream ground (#FAF7EF). Cream is the page; white means "object."
Do reserve terracotta for the one action that moves the user forward, and use exactly one per view (The One Door Rule).
Do set names in Playfair and everything else in DM Sans (The Naming Rule).
Do keep borders at 1.5px and visible. The edge is the form (The Visible Edge Rule).
Do express recessed states tonally with oat (#EEE8DC) rather than with inset shadows.
Do invert controls into white-alpha tiers on green or terracotta grounds instead of introducing a second palette (The Inversion Rule).
Do move interactive surfaces toward the cursor: 4px for cards, 1–2px for buttons, scale(1.1) for icon circles.
Do convert floating chrome to rgba(0,0,0,0.72) blurred pills when it sits over photography on mobile.
Do design every card and row for a missing thumbnail — an oat placeholder that pulses while loading and stops pulsing on error is the shipped behavior, and it is the common case.
Do make destruction two-step: hover to chili red, click to arm with a pulse, click again to commit.
Do extend prefers-reduced-motion coverage when adding motion. Only RecipeThumbnail currently honors it; the fan, panel slide, and banner entrance do not.
donts: Don't introduce a cool grey, a blue, or Inter. That combination is the generic-dashboard look this system is defined against.
Don't let a surface accumulate competing calls to attention — badges, banners, and promos stacked around content is the recipe-blog clutter the product exists to escape.
Don't use chili red for anything but destruction. It is not an accent.
Don't promote butter yellow to a surface color. It appears on the hero italic, the free badge, and the profile plane — that scarcity is what makes it read as highlight.
Don't give a pressable element a rounded rectangle. Pills for actions, 12px for fields, 20px for content.
Don't replace a border with a shadow, or thin a 1.5px border to 1px for "refinement."
Don't bring the profile page's oversized radii, overlapping planes, or fanned deck into task surfaces. Two registers, kept apart.
Don't spend weight 900 outside the profile composition — it is the signature register's ceiling, not a general emphasis tool.
Don't hand-write a focus ring. Use var(--ring-focus) so it stays derived from --primary.
Don't make a control row scroll horizontally; wrap it (The Wrap-Never-Scroll Rule).
